title: Shoes at 80% Off
intro: An ad for your favourite shoes pops up while you scroll. The price looks unreal.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

banner: Ad · you do not follow this page

msg.text: Strideway Runner shoes: 80% OFF today only!
We only take bank transfer or gift cards.

deal.label: 80% off
deal.lens: A brand-new shoe at a fifth of its usual price.
deal.why: A price far below normal is the bait. Real shops rarely cut this deep.

stock.label: "Only 3 left"
stock.lens: A countdown of pairs, to make you hurry.
stock.why: Pressure to buy now is a scam sign.

link.label: Strange shop address
link.lens: strideway-outlet-sale.shop is not the brand's own site, strideway.com.
link.why: Look-alike shop names are easy to make. Type the brand's own address yourself.

pay.label: Only transfer or gift cards
pay.lens: No card payment, only methods you cannot take back.
pay.why: Real shops accept cards, which can be disputed. Only scammers insist on transfers and gift cards.

reviews.label: Only perfect reviews
reviews.lens: Every review is five stars with no detail.
reviews.why: Fake shops write their own praise.

brand.label: A brand name
brand.lens: The page is called Strideway Outlet.
brand.why: A name is easy to copy. It proves nothing.

pic.label: A shoe picture
pic.lens: A photo of a running shoe.
pic.why: Pictures are copied from real shops in seconds.

price.why: The price is only suspicious next to the real one: the 80% discount.

actions.label: Click the ad and buy the shoes
Go to the brand's own website and compare

trap.title: Strideway Outlet · Checkout
trap.ask: Pay €24 by bank transfer to confirm your pair.

block_report.line: Reported the ad. The platform removed the page before it reached more people.

verify.line: The brand's real shop sold the same shoe at €120 and had never heard of this outlet. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The €24 went to a stranger. No shoes ever arrived, and the shop disappeared.

what_if.go_ahead: Looking up the brand's own site would have shown the true price. Paying by card would also have let you dispute the payment.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A price that looks too good, plus transfer-only payment, is a fake shop. Type the real shop's address yourself.

quick_check.q: An ad offers a €120 shoe for €24, payable only by bank transfer. What is the best move?

options.text: Buy fast, it is nearly sold out
Skip it, and check the brand's own website if you want the shoes
Ask the ad to confirm it is real

quick_check.explain: A huge discount with transfer-only payment is the pattern. Real shops accept cards.

hints.nudge: Look at the price and how they want to be paid.

rows.v: Use a card or a secure payment system that protects buyers
